impl_spec.method: binomial put-insurance closed-form (paper eq.6-9), NOT Black-Scholes (router queue def said BS; engine author used the paper's actual binomial method, no option market data).
impl_spec.p_index: market risk-neutral pi from BM monthly high/low (eq.6); stock fair price S0=(1/(1+r))[pi*S0u+(1-pi)*S0d] (eq.8); d_i=monthlow/fair; p_index=((1+delta)-d_i)/(1+delta)*(1-pi)/(1+r) (eq.7). delta=r.
impl_spec.direction: LOW = long low p-index (Score = -p_index). Pre-committed from paper Table 2 economic prior; HIGH leg NOT run for the gate (sweep avoidance).
impl_spec.r: 0.025/12 monthly constant. r is common across stocks at each date => cross-sectional rank-neutral (documented; does not affect long-only selection).
impl_spec.universe: KOSPI200 U KOSDAQ150 (PIT membership), top-25 EW long-only, monthly rebal, 2005-01~2026-06, 15bps.
impl_spec.pit: month-end signal from within-month OHLC (all observable at signal date); position held next month (t-1). run_alpha_search detect_lookahead = CLEAN (hard gate passed, full backtest produced). No full-sample stats, no scale()/fwd_ret/NEGATE.

SIGNAL-DEFINITION MISMATCH vs paper's NAMED strategies: the abstract's headline alphas are a 2x2 of efficient/inefficient x momentum/contrarian RELATIVE strategies (e.g. 'p-index-efficient-contrarian', 'p-index-inefficient-momentum'), which classify stocks by realized-vs-pindex performance then apply a holding rule. The engine (lines 96-100) implements a RAW p-index LEVEL cross-sectional sort (Score=+/-p_index), long the low-p-index quartile. A level-long-low sort is NOT any of the paper's tested named strategies — it is a derived proxy, not a replication of the paper's actual alphas.
